warnings: The large dark contextual story scrim remains visually dominant in several screenshots and may still be perceived as polished Web-demo framing.
The revised flow does not require inspecting all three bearings or enforce dwell time; human replay must judge whether voluntary observation creates enough situation and deliberation.
Physical-device accessibility, complete WCAG conformance, and all five failed human experience dimensions remain unverified until human replay.

feedbackFidelity.choiceClarity: Structurally addressed through required inspection before commit, three distinct offer/cost previews, reversible comparison, and no response or ending leakage.
feedbackFidelity.consequencePerceptibility: Implementation evidence shows multiple branch-specific world relationships changing before reflection, including geometry, route, marker, light/environment, and traveler position.
feedbackFidelity.feltAgency: A single persistent world shell transforms through state attributes instead of root or page replacement; felt consequence remains a human judgment.
feedbackFidelity.pacing: The flow now mechanically passes through arrival, approach, survey, inspection, deliberation, and explicit commit without timers; whether it feels sufficiently paced remains human-only.
feedbackFidelity.visualCoherence: The full-viewport landscape and in-world controls reduce card-oriented framing, but the contextual story scrim remains a material replaytest warning.

interactionDesignFindings: Pre-choice observation and meaningful tradeoff comparison are present before explicit commitment.
Preview is reversible and commitment is a separate event.
continuityFindings: Stable SVG landmarks and the same world-shell identity persist while geometry, route, light, marker, and viewpoint transform.
branchResponseFindings: Edge, wait, and gap have materially distinct immediate response states before continuation and ending.
Every branch requires one enacted continuation before reflection becomes available.
scopeFindings: The revision remains a bounded deterministic slice with no additional strategic choice, backend, persistence, audio, WebGL, framework, or M4.3 expansion.
accessibilityEngineeringFindings: Semantic controls, keyboard and touch-emulation paths, reduced motion, representative serious/critical axe scans, local-only networking, runtime-error collection, and deterministic replay are covered.
humanBoundary: This audit establishes readiness for human replaytest only. It does not declare any failed human experience dimension resolved.
